name: ByteChef
description: ByteChef is an open-source API integration and workflow automation platform. Workflows are built visually from 170+ connectors, conditions, loops and JavaScript, Python or Ruby code steps, and run manually, on a schedule or from webhooks.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first sign-up (Create account on the login page) becomes the administrator and closes sign-up. Anyone who reaches the port can claim it, so do it right away.
Webhook and OAuth2 URLs come from BYTECHEF_PUBLIC_URL in /opt/bytechef_data/.env. Behind a reverse proxy or domain, change it and run systemctl restart bytechef.
This build runs the Enterprise Edition. Its enterprise modules (embedded iPaaS, API platform, AI gateway, SSO, audit log) are free for development and testing; production use needs a subscription.
